title: KANTO RELEASE-CRITICAL >=1000 MUST-COVERAGE AUDIT
scope: Kanto live/theater/concert/large ticketed-event facility-spaces: an official normal or event configuration at >=1,000. Capacity is discovery-only, never numbered-seat evidence.
evidencePolicy: Current first-party issuer information establishes identity, operation, capacity and event-use discovery. Secondary data is discovery-only and never establishes seat evidence or a production decision. No capacity fitting, inferred IDs, third-party seat maps, source JSON/ranges, fingerprints, catalog or runtime changes were made.

Current official first-party facility research for regional large-venue gaps.
Identity/alias/facility-space reconciliation by stable inventory ID.
